title: LeetLLM video quality rubric
scope: Editorial assessment of the script and current encoded scene, motion, and native-resolution samples, supported by automated production audits. A score is not a claim of continuous human playback or full audible listening.

dimensions.title: Technical correctness
dimensions.criteria: Accurate definitions, calculations, units, causal claims, diagrams, and qualifications. Narration and displayed state agree.

dimensions.title: Teaching from first principles
dimensions.criteria: A motivating introduction, necessary definitions, a coherent explanation, natural examples, and a useful synthesis. Examples develop the underlying ideas.

dimensions.title: Visual clarity
dimensions.criteria: Legible typography and mathematical notation, balanced composition, clear connections and labels, and adequate spacing. Important information fits and remains visible.

dimensions.title: Explanatory animation
dimensions.criteria: Motion explains a change, computation, or causal relationship. State changes follow the spoken explanation. Visual continuity helps the learner follow the objects.

dimensions.title: Narration and pacing
dimensions.criteria: Natural teaching language, manageable numerical detail, measured speaking rate, useful pauses, and enough time to inspect each important visual. Audible delivery requires a separate listening review.

dimensions.title: Production and accessibility
dimensions.criteria: Current encoded-media validation, a consistent opening, clean output, native captions and chapters, and working playback. Audio measurements support this dimension without establishing pronunciation quality.

bands.label: Exceptional
bands.description: Unusually strong teaching and visual execution; only minor subjective refinements remain.

bands.label: Strong
bands.description: Clear and effective, with specific opportunities to improve presentation or depth.

bands.label: Competent
bands.description: Useful instruction with material improvements still worth making.

bands.label: Needs revision
bands.description: Significant teaching or presentation weaknesses remain.

bands.label: Needs substantial work
bands.description: Major weaknesses prevent a confident recommendation.

scoring: Award integer points for demonstrated quality. Explain each deduction. Automated passes support production reliability; they do not determine editorial scores. Record unresolved correctness, clipping, overlap, or synchronization defects as blockers regardless of total. Rebind and review the score whenever the movie or render sources change.
